name: AGROVOC Field
description: Auto-suggests AGROVOC taxonomy tags for content on save by calling a self-hosted AgroTagger service.
project_description: Suggests AGROVOC concept tags for a taxonomy reference field from the text of another field on the same content, by calling a self-hosted AgroTagger HTTP service (POST /tag). It is a Drupal 11 port of the legacy Drupal 7 agrovocfield_automatic sub-module. Automatic indexing is a per-widget third-party setting (added to core's Autocomplete tags widget and the Tagify contrib widget): when enabled, an #element_validate callback reads the just-submitted source-field text, calls the service, and looks up or creates matching taxonomy terms in the field's target vocabulary, filling the field only when the editor left it empty. Newly created terms get their canonical AGROVOC URI stored in a field_agrovoc_uri link field when the vocabulary has one. Because it runs only as a form #element_validate callback, it never fires on programmatic saves, migrations or imports. The AgroTagger service (a self-hosted wrapper around the MAUI keyphrase-extraction library) is configured by an administrator; the module only speaks its POST /tag and GET /lookup JSON API.
